title: List of Adventure Time characters
blurb: The Ice King's ever-present penguin servant in Adventure Time — revealed partway through the series to secretly be an ancient, world-ending cosmic entity named Orgalorg.
facts: Finn and Jake live in the post-apocalyptic Land of Ooo, where they travel on various adventures.
Along the way, they interact with the other main characters of the show: Princess Bubblegum, the Ice King, Simon Petrikov, and Marceline the Vampire Queen.
